canonical_data: Markdown plan, spec, and progress files written into the target repository
strengths: A coherent seven-gated RIPER-5 workflow (research through update-process), not a loose prompt collection, with 36 mechanical validators guarding the kit's own structure
Runs entirely against the user's own local repository across many coding-agent hosts (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot)
A resumable run-until-done token lets an autopilot run survive a fresh session
weaknesses: No commits, releases, or version bumps in the roughly three months before this review despite an actively marketed autopilot workflow
Explicitly promotes running with '0 need for human gate,' trading away the approval checkpoints its own gated phases otherwise provide
Reliability, cost-estimate, and self-healing claims are vendor-authored marketing copy with no independent benchmark or test evidence in the bundle
why_it_matters: Shows a heavily gated, self-healing prompt-and-validator workflow can be layered onto an existing coding agent instead of requiring a new agent runtime.
